about: Written by e2er at export (2026-10-15) from what the run recorded: the scripts that wrote estimation_results.json, from the estimation script on, in the order the run ran them (its script log); the files they read; and the packages they import. code/requirements.txt pins 2 package(s) at the versions the run used.

steps.about: load the inputs the folder does not ship (if any)
data preparation: builds data/gaia_clean.csv again from the data loaded again

inputs.source: a file the study's code reads

Gaia Data Release 3 (ESA/Gaia/DPAC), Gaia ESA Archive, Gaia archive ADQL query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', 56.75, 24.12)) AS dist_deg, parallax, parallax_error, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved, visibility_periods_used, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_g_mean_flux_over_error, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 56.75, 24.12, 3)) AND parallax > 2 AND parallax_over_error > 5, release DR3, loaded 2026-10-13

notes: ESA Gaia Data Release 3's terms allow non-commercial use only, with credit to ESA/Gaia/DPAC (CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO), so a published study may leave its data out. get_data.py loads these data again with e2er-data when the folder lacks them.
The run recorded no Python version for its scripts (e2er up to 0.16.0), so the recipe names the Python e2er exported the study with (3.12.12); the study may have run on another.

Built from data whose terms keep them out of a published study: data/gaia_clean.csv (code/scratch/clean_gaia.py). When the folder lacks one, the script in brackets builds it again from the data get_data.py loads.
